snippet.title: The Perfect Pencil - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Lost in the kingdom of the white beast, will you find your way out? The Perfect Pencil is a story-driven action platformer that throws you into the innermost depths of the human mind. Navigate surreal worlds punctuated by bizzare personalities, tense boss battles and secrets. 

She’s waiting for you on January 29th!

Steam: https://disobey.cc/ThePerfectPencil_Dis
